cleanup.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $profile='C:\sgSHIOK2026\tmp\layout-confirmation-browser-xzP7gb'; function Owned { @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='chrome.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine.Contains($profile) }) }; $before=@(Owned | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine); foreach($p in @(Owned)){ $live=Get-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($live -and -not $live.HasExited){Stop-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue} }; $until=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(20); do { $remaining=@(Owned | Where-Object { $p=Get-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $p -and -not $p.HasExited }); if($remaining.Count -eq 0){break}; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 } while([DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $until); @{before=$before;remaining=@($remaining | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress
